_comment: A `tbzl.buildconfig/v1` document as the platform would serve it for the live plane.
⚠ SCRUBBED AND NON-EXECUTABLE BY CONSTRUCTION: this document contains no secret and
cannot contain one. The protocol carries a token URL, a scope and an issuer — the
coordinates for MINTING a credential — and never a credential. That is deliberate:
a served profile is cached, logged by --announce_rc, and attached to build records,
so anything secret in it would be secret in all three.
⛔ The exec-property container-image is an opaque ROUTING TOKEN the scheduler
string-compares and NEVER fetches. The account id in it is meaningless; do not 'fix' it.

recommendations.basis: analytic/2026-08-05.1 — jobs raised 64→200: concurrency sat at exactly 64 for a majority of busy wall on a ~4h aion build while the fleet had slots free, so --jobs was binding. remote_max_connections=200 from 6.3 MB/s measured per stream, flat across 4 concurrent streams (latency 0.46 ms), where input fetch dominated action time.
